open-door-community-church.assessment: Open Door Community Church at 565 White Oak Rd (near River Road, south Fredericksburg/Falmouth area) shows up in local directories as an active, growing congregation. MapQuest notes they have had ongoing building expansion plans — a sign of a growing, healthy church. The church offers three services per week (two on Sunday, one Wednesday), which indicates more than a nominal gathering. However, with no website, no social media presence found, and only a first name for the pastor ('Pastor Ron'), it's genuinely impossible to score theological alignment beyond reasonable Baptist assumptions. Before visiting, call the church directly, ask for their statement of faith, confirm the pastor's last name and background, and inquire about denominational affiliation. Note: The address 565 White Oak Rd is also listed in one local resource as the location of a Spanish-language congregation (Iglesia Cristo La Roca) — possible co-location or address change. Confirm current tenants before visiting.
